notes: Texas meets in regular session only in ODD years (140-day session, Tex. Const.) — there is NO 2026 regular session; the 90th Legislature next convenes 2027-01-12. Dates above are the 89th Legislature's 2025 session ('Day 119' committee cutoff for House bills, 'Day 123' House floor deadline used as crossoverDate, 'Day 131' second-chamber committee cutoff, 'Day 140' sine die). Texas has no rule-codified 'crossover day' or Senate committee-report deadline as such — crossoverDate/committeeCutoffDate above are the nearest House-side rule deadlines (the practical equivalents); the Senate's binding constraint is its own floor deadline ('Day 134', not modeled as a separate column).
